_why: Hand corrections applied on top of the sampled values in swatches.json, made by eye against scripts/out/sheets/*.png. The sampler is reliable on plain-backdrop studio shots (both kurtas needed no correction at all) but drifts grey on location shots, where an archway wall or the model's cream top out-votes the garment. Prints are approximations by nature - see _prints.
_prints: A single hex cannot represent a multi-colour floral. The values for ANNA TOP and ANAYA COTTON are the dominant accent of each print, chosen so the swatches stay distinguishable from each other. Better UX would render the print photo itself as the swatch - product_images already stores a per-colour image, so this is a UI change, not a data one.
